game.core.world.fact.summary: The Tensor Sect raised Ganji as a prodigy and does not easily let go of what it considers its own. If Ganji ever makes a serious, lasting break from them, the Sect may dispatch monks to retrieve him. This is a live, unresolved threat for the GM to invoke at a dramatically appropriate moment, not a scheduled event.
game.core.world.fact.provenance: GM worldbuilding note, from player-provided character background
